finding.text: One link still builds the flat url (requirement 2): `public/framework/ai/AISession/SessionTasksGrid.js:49` hrefs the Tasks grid's "Session" cell with `AICost.session_url(r.owner)`, which is `/framework/ai/sessions/<id>/`. It should use `AICost.session_href(r.owner)` like the four links fixed in 40311faff.

Commit 9ea688364 swept in 100+ files that have nothing to do with this task: every regenerated `files.jsonl`, 13 `ai/board.jsonl` lines, a `sessions/task-moves.jsonl` line, and lines in `public/live/page.jsonl` (`{"file":"failures.jsonl","gone":true}`, `{"file":"truth/page.js"}`) and `public/live/design/page.jsonl`. The rule is to commit by exact path. Those /live/ lines are also why review.mjs shot /live/ and /live/design/. Drop them from the branch before merging; another agent owns that data.

Some live text still points at the flat path (requirement 3). The worst is `core/Page/doc/architecture.md:61`: this same diff edited that file, yet the line still says the hook names "`/framework/ai/sessions/<session id>/`". Also `Servex/agents/Agents.js:227` (comment: "its own page, /framework/ai/sessions/<session_id>/"), the `Servex/agents/page_tools.js:74,78` doc comment ("a session page, `/framework/ai/sessions/<id>/`"), `ai/sessions/doc/asks/asks.md:15` ("Every row opens `/framework/ai/sessions/<id>/`") and `ux/Dictate/doc/asks.md:92`.

The new `AICost.session_href` is not in any readme. The AITask readme never names it or `session_url`, and the AISession readme only says links go through `AISession.page_url`. A fresh agent would not know that `session_url` is now "the cost-summary key, never a link". Add one line to the AITask readme, beside the cost line text (`AICost.summary(AICost.session_url(id))`) in the AISession readme.

A fresh agent could not continue from this task folder alone. Deliverable 1 asked for a list of every place. The log has one summary line ("~20 live docs (fixed)") that lists neither the docs that were fixed nor the places left alone on purpose (Mention's fallback href, SessionConsolidate, session-place, the turn-costs parser). The log names 2 commits, but the branch holds 3 (9ea688364 is missing). The task was closed by the harness ("ended its turn without completing its own task"), not by the agent itself.
`ai/sessions/doc/views-plan.md` keeps the heading "The session detail (flat URL)" above a line that now gives the dated url. The heading contradicts the line.

Servex must restart before the new `page_tools.js` PAGE_PATH text and `Agents.folder_line` take effect. The SessionStart hook takes effect once this merges: this reviewer's own start line still printed the old "/framework/ai/sessions/<uuid>/ is only a redirect" text.

Five links in live code still build the flat `/framework/ai/sessions/<id>/` url (requirement 2). They are `ext/Refine/PromptView.js:96` and `:101`, `ai/rail/DashRow.js:53` (a dashboard row), `core/Page/PageInbox.js:111` and `core/Role/RoleView.js:69`. They build the url by string concatenation, so the brief's grep pattern never found them. The task log lists PromptView as "left on purpose" and uses it as the reason to keep the redirect, but requirement 2 says code that builds a flat link must build the dated one instead. Each should use `AICost.session_href(id)` (or `AISession.page_url(id)`). Once they do, the redirect decision should be checked again. The fallback in `Mention.js:113` is documented and can stay.

The census in the task log is incomplete, so a fresh agent would trust a list that misses item 1. Deliverable 1 asked for every place that builds the flat url. Add the five files above to the "Places" log line, or give the grep that finds concatenated urls (`git grep -n -E "ai/sessions/\" *\+|ai/sessions/\$\{" -- 'public/**/*.js'`).

Servex must restart before the new `page_tools.js` PAGE_PATH text and `Agents.folder_line` take effect. The SessionStart hook text changes once this merges: this reviewer's own start line still printed the old "/framework/ai/sessions/<uuid>/ is only a redirect" wording. The minion said so, and a restart was asked of voice-app.

`AICost.session_href` depends on `AISession.slugs` already being loaded. On a surface that has not scanned the index, the link falls back to the flat url and goes through the redirect. That is harmless while the redirect stays, but it is one more thing that depends on it.

The `/live/` and `/live/design/` shot folders are left over from round 1, when the swept-in commit 9ea688364 touched their `page.jsonl`. That commit is gone (the branch is 4 commits and 35 files, the same as diff.patch), so those shots are not evidence for this change.

Server-side code still builds flat `/framework/ai/sessions/<uuid>/` links and writes them into committed files (requirement 2). `Server/AskIndex.mjs:47` (`AskIndex.link`, written into module inboxes at :157 and :260), `Servex/ext/refine/TagRouter.js:63` (the tag note's text), `Servex/ext/refine/CardAsk.js:39` (a card's `source`) and `Server/RefineQueue.mjs:171` (the prompt page fallback). All four run in node, where `SessionFolders.at(store).of(id)` gives the dated folder. Until they change, every new note or card adds another link that needs the redirect, and the decision to keep the redirect rests on those links.

The census in the task log still leaves out the node/Servex builders in finding 1 (and `Servex/ext/refine/VoicePage.js:37`, `page_tools.js:200` `own_page`, which pass a flat path to the page tools as input). It neither fixes them nor says they were left on purpose, so a fresh agent working from the folder alone would think the census is complete (deliverable 1). Rounds 1 and 2 grepped only `public/*.js`. A grep that also covers node: `git grep -n -E 'ai/sessions/\$\{(session|id|who|p\.session)\}/' -- Server Servex`.

`Servex/agents/doc/own-page.md:14` still says "the url `/framework/ai/sessions/<id>/` only redirects there". That is true, but this same diff rewrote line 6 of the file to "its one dated folder", so the old wording now sits beside the new. Reword it to match agents.md ("a bare-uuid url is a browser-only redirect for old links").

Servex must restart before the new `page_tools.js` PAGE_PATH text and `Agents.folder_line` take effect. The hook text changes on merge: this reviewer's own start line still printed the old "/framework/ai/sessions/<uuid>/ is only a redirect" wording.

The one page change (`ux/Dictate/surfaces/page.js`, the text of one table cell) sits below the fold in every shot. It does not change layout, so the shots stand as evidence that the page still draws, not as a view of the edited cell.
